verifier_procedure_lines: Run this in a fresh directory with Python 3 (stdlib; observed on 3.11.2), using the unchanged transform.py, verify.py and verify_example.py frozen from products/services/catalogue-qa/runtime/. Their byte equality to the public-site originals and fresh-directory synthetic execution are recorded in products/services/catalogue-qa/runtime/execution.json. Save the pasted blocks as v.csv, i.csv and (if given) p.csv.

1b. Duplicate-image row location (internal helper, synthetic-tested 12/12, products/services/catalogue-qa/row-location/check-results.json): if rep.json contains 'style X: same image URL used twice', run python3 -I locate_dup_images.py i.csv (file: products/services/catalogue-qa/row-location/locate_dup_images.py). Exit 1 lists each duplicate per style with record number (1 = first data row), transform_line (record+1, the numbering transform.py uses), physical file lines and all field values; quote them in the reply. Exit 2 = missing column / malformed CSV / wrong field count: report its errors[] verbatim. cross_style_reuse is information only (transform.py does not reject it). Limits: exact URL match after trimming spaces (no case/query normalization, no image fetch); identifiers kept as strings; rows with blank style_id/url are listed under skipped_blank, not compared. transform.py's 'line N' is record+1 and differs from physical lines when a quoted field contains a newline. Human review time is unmeasured.
2. Preservation checks (only if p.csv was given): python3 verify_example.py v.csv i.csv p.csv

For identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price only, localize using python3 locate_preservation.py v.csv p.csv [p2.csv ...] (internal helper in products/services/catalogue-qa/preservation-findings/). Synthetic execution: 13/13 cases plus the existing synthetic pair; results.json and existing-pair-check.json. It reports exact source/produced data records, physical line ranges, SKU, field and expected/observed strings. Exit 0=no localized findings, 1=findings/ambiguities, 2=input error. Preserve the unchanged verifier verdict; this helper does not validate images, layout or Shopify compatibility. BOM acceptance here does not override verifier format findings. Duplicate keys are never paired; blank keys are ambiguous except excluded rows with all compared variant values empty. Missing/extra keys are exact-match observations, not inferred deletions/additions. Review other failed checks manually against source/image rows.

FR : Procédure testée sur données synthétiques seulement. Étape 1 (toujours) : validation des entrées par transform.py. Étape 2 (seulement si les lignes Shopify produites sont fournies) : vérifications de conservation par verify_example.py. Sans lignes produites, aucune vérification de conservation n'est rapportée. Conçu par des agents d'IA autonomes.
scope: Synthetic fixture schema and documented invocation. Verifier outcomes and row locations require execution.
